<script setup lang="ts">
import { toRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import StopCard from './Stop.vue';
import { copyStop, type Day } from './trip';

const props = defineProps<{ day: Day }>();
const zone = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('zone');
const listRef = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');

const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(listRef, {
  id: props.day.id,
  items: toRef(props.day, 'stops'),
  // Lists of one group trade items.
  group: 'trip',
  // Hold Alt while dragging, and the stop is copied instead of moved.
  clone: copyStop,
  // The whole column takes drops, below its last stop too.
  dropzone: zone,
});
</script>

<template>
  <section ref="zone" class="day" :class="{ over: isOver }">
    <h3>
      {{ day.title }}
      <span class="count">{{ items.length }}</span>
    </h3>
    <ul ref="list" class="stops">
      <StopCard v-for="stop in items" :key="stop.id" :stop="stop" />
    </ul>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import type { Stop } from './trip';

const props = defineProps<{ stop: Stop }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// `selected` lives in the provider's selection: drag one selected stop, and they all come.
const { selected } = makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.stop });

const onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) selected.value = !selected.value;
};
</script>

<template>
  <li ref="el" class="stop" :class="{ selected }" :style="{ '--tone': stop.tone }" @click="onClick">
    <span class="time">{{ stop.time }}</span>
    <span class="title">{{ stop.title }}</span>
  </li>
</template>

<style scoped>

export interface Stop {
  id: string;
  time: string;
  title: string;
  tone: string;
}

export interface Day {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  stops: Stop[];
}

const FOOD = '#f59e0b';
const SIGHT = '#3b82f6';
const WALK = '#42b883';

export const DAYS: Day[] = [
  {
    id: 'ideas',
    title: 'Ideas',
    stops: [
      { id: 'market', time: '—', title: 'Flea market', tone: SIGHT },
      { id: 'ramen', time: '—', title: 'Late ramen', tone: FOOD },
      { id: 'river', time: '—', title: 'River walk', tone: WALK },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'sat',
    title: 'Saturday',
    stops: [
      { id: 'coffee', time: '09:00', title: 'Coffee at Mo’s', tone: FOOD },
      { id: 'museum', time: '11:00', title: 'Design museum', tone: SIGHT },
      { id: 'park', time: '15:00', title: 'Botanic park', tone: WALK },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'sun',
    title: 'Sunday',
    stops: [
      { id: 'brunch', time: '10:30', title: 'Brunch', tone: FOOD },
      { id: 'tower', time: '13:00', title: 'Old tower', tone: SIGHT },
    ],
  },
];

let copies = 0;
/** A copy (Alt-drag) is a new stop: same plan, its own id. */
export const copyStop = (stop: Stop): Stop => ({ ...stop, id: `${stop.id}-copy-${++copies}` });

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive } from 'vue';
import { useKeyModifier } from '@vueuse/core';
import { useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Day from './Day.vue';
import { DAYS } from './trip';

const days = reactive(structuredClone(DAYS));

// The drag, read anywhere under the provider: what the gestures are doing right now.
const { status, active, selection } = useDnD();
const alt = useKeyModifier('Alt');
const selected = computed(() => selection.ids.size);
const byKeys = computed(() => status.value === 'dragging' && active.value?.sensor === 'keyboard');
</script>

<template>
  <div class="trip">
    <div class="days">
      <Day v-for="day in days" :key="day.id" :day="day" />
    </div>
    <footer class="gestures">
      <span :class="{ on: selected }">
        <kbd>Ctrl/⌘</kbd> + click
        <b>{{ selected ? `${selected} selected` : 'select' }}</b>
        <button v-if="selected" type="button" aria-label="Clear the selection" @click="selection.clear()">×</button>
      </span>
      <span :class="{ on: alt && status === 'dragging' }"><kbd>Alt</kbd> + drag <b>copy</b></span>
      <span :class="{ on: byKeys }"><kbd>Space</kbd> + arrows <b>keyboard</b></span>
    </footer>
  </div>
</template>
